name: Failure
overview: Scripture acknowledges human failure as an inevitable reality, illustrated by the truth that all have sinned and fallen short of God's glory (Romans 3:23). Yet, God remains our unwavering strength and support, upholding those who fall and empowering them to rise again (Psalms 73:26; Psalms 145:14; Proverbs 24:16). Genuine repentance, marked by confessing and forsaking sin, invites God's mercy and restoration (Proverbs 28:13). Moreover, God’s plans for His people are rooted in hope and a future of peace, assuring believers that failure does not define their ultimate destiny (Jeremiah 29:11).
